evidence.observation: Monotone pressure rise during growth, 2.95→3.16 Torr over k=20..25, far beyond the ~0.02 Torr scatter seen in purge/ramp
Flow steady at 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from a flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~44%; thermal control nominal
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak status cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) or an equivalent leak/backpressure test — e.g. a brief Ar step-down or pump-isolation rate-of-rise — to distinguish exhaust blockage from a seal leak.
